title: Russell Flint in Action
content: AN ARTIST aka SIR WILLIAM RUSSELL FLINT, RA(Video link) Here's a film from 1956 of British artist Sir William Russell Flint, RA (1880-1969).The film shows him laying out his watercolor palette, posing his model, and applying his wet washes. Flint typically worked from live models in his studio.More about Sir William Russell Flint on WikipediaFlint bio on Jim Vadeboncoeur's website------On Monday I'll be giving a talk on composition at theAcademy of Realist Artin Toronto. July 30, 2012 @ 6:30 pm.
